summary.text: Victor Rountree is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 3, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Victor Rountree's occupation as a senior pastor.

paragraphs.text: Victor Rountree was born on June 16, 1959, in Wilson, North Carolina.

Victor Rountree graduated from Elm City High School in 1977, earned an A.A. in financial management in 1990 and an A.A. in personnel management in 2001 from the Community College of the Air Force, and earned a B.S. in business management and accounting from the University of Maryland European Division in 1993.
Victor Rountree served in the U.S. Air Force from 1980 to 2010, held the rank of Chief Master Sergeant, and also worked as a program delivery manager at the Federal Emergency Management Agency.
Victor Rountree is a member of Endure to the End Ministries.
Victor Rountree married Cheryl James on January 6, 1983, and they have three children.
